visual_logic.surface_detail: Rugged skin with 'Dark Charcoal' dorsal coloring and subtle scarring to indicate a high-tier predator status.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Emphasis on the 'bitey' nature of the snout—shorter and more robust than Ophthalmosaurus, with prominent teeth.
visual_logic.environment: Murky, nutrient-dense Jurassic waters with suspended sediment.
visual_logic.pose: A head-on 'jaws-open' lunge toward the camera, emphasizing its role as an apex predator.
